functions.name: sync_company_public_name
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.sync_company_public_name()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 insert into public.company_public_names(company_id,company_name)
 values(new.id,coalesce(new.company_name,'企業名未設定'))
 on conflict(company_id) do update set company_name=excluded.company_name;
 return new;
end;
$function$
